info.title: SIH26170 Burn-in Screening API
info.description:
Backend for SIH26170 - AI-driven anomaly detection in component burn-in and screening.

**What this service does**

* flags components that drift unusually compared with comparable peers in the
  same batch, including parts still inside the specification limit;
* where an artifact supports it, predicts the 168 h measurement from the 0 h and
  24 h readings, with an explanation and, when calibrated, an uncertainty interval.

**What the numbers are not**

* the anomaly score is a relative deviation score, not a probability of physical
  failure and not a confidence level;
* feature contributions explain model behaviour; they do not establish a physical
  cause such as water ingress or cracking;
* a nominal interval is only as good as its held-out calibration, which is
  reported per artifact rather than per record.

`percent_change` is a **fraction**: 0.1 means 10 %.

get.description: Returns 200 whenever the process is running. It says nothing about model availability.

Returns 200 only when the configured mode's artifacts, schema, checksums and a small inference probe all pass. Otherwise 503 with the specific reason for each capability. Demo mode requires both anomaly and forecast.

Lists every family/measurement profile the service knows about. A profile is usable only when its definition is 'supported' AND its artifacts are loaded. Planned profiles are listed so the roadmap is visible; they are never scoreable and 'usable' is false for them.

post.description: Accepts a long-format burn-in CSV as multipart form field 'file'. Only the validated 0/24 h -> 168 h mode is supported, so as_of_hour must be 24. The file is processed in memory; raw measurement values are never logged. Histories missing a required checkpoint are returned as explicit unscored records rather than being silently dropped.

413.description: Upload exceeds the size or row limit.

415.description: Payload is not a text CSV file.

422.description: The file is invalid or nothing in it is eligible.

503.description: A required model or core module is unavailable.

get.summary: Download the labelled synthetic sample CSV
get.description: A deterministic slice of the project's synthetic MLCC_X7R / leakage_ua demonstration data, with 0 h and 24 h readings plus the 168 h outcome. Every row is marked synthetic in its data_source column: it is generated data for demonstrating the pipeline, NOT measured hardware.

score.title: Score
score.description: Relative deviation score from the fitted detector. NOT a probability of physical failure and not a confidence level.

reason_codes.title: Reason Codes
reason_codes.description: Plain-language reason codes from the core detector.

score_kind.title: Score Kind
score_kind.description: The core's own description of what the score is, e.g. 'ranking score, not failure probability'.

model_score.title: Model Score
model_score.description: Isolation Forest component of the score.

as_of_hour.title: As Of Hour
as_of_hour.description: Cutoff hour. Only 24 is validated for this pilot.

forecast_model.title: Forecast Model
forecast_model.description: Optional forecast model to request from the bundle. Omit to use the artifact's own internal-validation winner. The response always reports which model actually produced the forecasts, and warns when the requested one is not the validation winner.

outcome_file.title: Outcome File
outcome_file.description: OPTIONAL second CSV of observations strictly AFTER the cutoff, for the outcome reveal. Matched to the main file on component_id, batch_id, component_family and measurement_name. Its values and any limits it carries are never used to build features, produce forecasts or change recommendations - comparison limits come from the early file. Omit it and the endpoint behaves exactly as before. This is a presentation convenience, not a blind-testing mechanism.

intervals.title: Intervals
intervals.description: Whether calibrated prediction intervals are available.

reason.title: Reason
reason.description: Why the capability is unavailable. Null when available.

checks.title: Checks
checks.description: Artifact presence, schema, checksum and inference-probe results.

ComponentSummary.title: ComponentSummary
ComponentSummary.description:
Documented aggregation across the measurements of one component.

``summary_recommendation`` is the most urgent SCORED recommendation. It is
null when no measurement of the component was scored. ``partial_coverage``
is true whenever at least one measurement went unscored - the UI must not
render such a component as fully passed.

DataProvenance.title: DataProvenance
DataProvenance.description:
How the data reaching the API was produced.

``MEASURED_UNVERIFIED`` is an uploader's *claim* of hardware data. The API
cannot independently verify provenance, so a claim is never promoted to
verified, and an absent ``data_source`` column stays ``UNKNOWN``.

value.title: Value
value.description: Offending value as text, included only for schema/identity fields. Raw measurement values are never echoed back.

ErrorDetail.title: ErrorDetail
ErrorDetail.description:
One specific problem inside an upload.

``row`` is the 1-based line number in the submitted CSV *including* the
header line, so the first data row is ``2``. It is null whenever the
problem is dataset-level rather than row-level.

source_filename.title: Source Filename
source_filename.description: Filename of the separate outcome file these came from, when one was uploaded. Null when the outcomes were extra rows in the main file.

kind.title: Kind
kind.description: 'observed_readings' means real later measurements. 'simulation_truth' means latent generator values, which are NOT sensor measurements and must be labelled as such in the UI.

note.title: Note
note.description: States that these values were excluded from all inference.

interval_nominal_coverage.title: Interval Nominal Coverage
interval_nominal_coverage.description: Nominal coverage of the interval, e.g. 0.9. Empirical coverage is reported per-artifact in the manifest, not per-record, and may differ.

interval_method.title: Interval Method
interval_method.description: e.g. 'split_conformal'. Null when no calibrated interval is available.

interval_stratum.title: Interval Stratum
interval_stratum.description: For the stratified v2 interval: which 24 h slope robust-z stratum supplied the margins (slope_z_stratum_0: z < 2, 1: 2 to 5, 2: >= 5).

upper_bound_nominal_level.title: Upper Bound Nominal Level
upper_bound_nominal_level.description: For the stratified v2 interval: nominal one-sided level of prediction_upper (0.9 means about 10 % of comparable synthetic parts end above it). The pair (prediction_lower, prediction_upper) is then an 80 % interval.

prediction_lower_two_sided.title: Prediction Lower Two Sided
prediction_lower_two_sided.description: Wider two-sided 90 % lower bound (v2 stratified interval only).

prediction_upper_two_sided.title: Prediction Upper Two Sided
prediction_upper_two_sided.description: Wider two-sided 90 % upper bound (v2 stratified interval only).

predicted_to_cross_limit.title: Predicted To Cross Limit
predicted_to_cross_limit.description: Whether the point prediction crosses the applicable limit at target_hour.

explanation.title: Explanation
explanation.description: Feature contributions explaining model behaviour. These do not establish a physical cause such as water ingress or cracking.

interval_warning.title: Interval Warning
interval_warning.description: The artifact's own caveat about what the nominal level does and does not mean.

out_of_training_range_features.title: Out Of Training Range Features
out_of_training_range_features.description: Inputs beyond the ranges observed in training. Non-empty means the forecast extrapolates and its interval coverage does not transfer.

missing_optional_features.title: Missing Optional Features
missing_optional_features.description: Optional inputs that were absent and median-imputed.

xgboost_candidate_final_value.title: Xgboost Candidate Final Value
xgboost_candidate_final_value.description: The XGBoost candidate's forecast, reported separately. It is NOT a substitute for predicted_final_value unless forecast_model is 'xgboost'.

LimitDirection.title: LimitDirection
LimitDirection.description: Which side of the specification counts as a failure.

applicable_limit.title: Applicable Limit
applicable_limit.description: The limit the decision was actually taken against.

headroom.title: Headroom
headroom.description: Signed distance from the latest early value to the applicable limit, in measurement units.

headroom_fraction.title: Headroom Fraction
headroom_fraction.description: headroom divided by the applicable limit. Null when the limit is zero.

limit_fraction.title: Limit Fraction
limit_fraction.description: latest_value divided by the applicable limit.

selected_model.title: Selected Model
selected_model.description: The model that produced the forecasts in this response.

validation_winner.title: Validation Winner
validation_winner.description: Lowest-error model on internal validation batches.

selection_warning.title: Selection Warning
selection_warning.description: Non-null when the selected model is not the validation winner.

model_training_data.title: Model Training Data
model_training_data.description: Provenance of the TRAINING data. Separate from the uploaded file's provenance.

model_fitted_during_request.title: Model Fitted During Request
model_fitted_during_request.description: The core's own declaration. Must be false.

ModelInfo.title: ModelInfo
ModelInfo.description:
Identity and honest provenance of the models that produced this response.

``selected_model`` is the model that ACTUALLY produced every
``predicted_final_value``. ``validation_winner`` is the model that scored
best on internal validation. When they differ, ``selection_warning`` is
non-null, and the UI must not imply the selected model outperformed the
baseline.

applicable_limit.title: Applicable Limit
applicable_limit.description: The specification limit this outcome was compared against, taken from the uploaded history. Null when the upload declared no limit for this component.

crossed_applicable_limit.title: Crossed Applicable Limit
crossed_applicable_limit.description: True when the observed value breached the applicable limit. NULL means the limit was unknown, so no comparison was possible - it does NOT mean the component stayed inside its limit.

OutcomeRecord.title: OutcomeRecord
OutcomeRecord.description:
EVALUATION ONLY.

Populated from observations after the cutoff when the upload contains them.
These values never enter feature building, scoring, peer statistics or
explanations. The section is omitted entirely for early-only uploads.

sample_size.title: Sample Size
sample_size.description: Number of comparable peers in the same batch/family/measurement/condition.

sufficient.title: Sufficient
sufficient.description: False when sample_size is below the profile's min_peer_group_size.

current_batch_robust_z.title: Current Batch Robust Z
current_batch_robust_z.description: Robust z-score of the cutoff value against comparable peers in the batch.

slope_batch_robust_z.title: Slope Batch Robust Z
slope_batch_robust_z.description: Robust z-score of the early slope against the same peers.

warning.title: Warning
warning.description: The core's own peer-comparison caveat, e.g. fewer than eight peers.

PeerStatistics.title: PeerStatistics
PeerStatistics.description: Batch-relative context for one measurement, computed from early data only.

status.description: 'supported' means the profile definition is complete; it still needs artifacts to run.

min_peer_group_size.title: Min Peer Group Size
min_peer_group_size.description: Below this many comparable peers, batch-relative statistics are reported as unavailable.

usable.title: Usable
usable.description: True only when status is 'supported' AND the required artifacts are loaded.

supported_part_profiles.title: Supported Part Profiles
supported_part_profiles.description: Part/test profile ids the loaded artifact was trained on. When non-empty, each uploaded row must carry a profile_id from this list or its history is reported unscored.

mode.title: Mode
mode.description: 'demo' requires anomaly + forecast; 'anomaly_only' is a development mode.

limitations.title: Limitations
limitations.description: Human-readable limitations of the current mode. Non-empty in anomaly_only mode.

Recommendation.title: Recommendation
Recommendation.description: Preserved verbatim from the core decision module.

duration_ms.title: Duration Ms
duration_ms.description: Measured server-side processing time for this request.

measurement_record_count.title: Measurement Record Count
measurement_record_count.description: Number of (component, measurement) histories present in the upload.

evaluation.description: Omitted when the upload contains only early data.

recommendation_basis.title: Recommendation Basis
recommendation_basis.description: 'anomaly_and_forecast' or 'anomaly_only' (provisional when the forecast is unavailable).

provisional.title: Provisional
provisional.description: True when the recommendation was reached without a forecast.

last_observation_hour.title: Last Observation Hour
last_observation_hour.description: Hour of the latest reading used for inference (the cutoff).

percent_change.title: Percent Change
percent_change.description: FRACTION, not a percentage. 0.1 means 10 %. Null when initial_value is 0.

percent_change_available.title: Percent Change Available
percent_change_available.description: False when initial_value is zero, where a displayable percentage is undefined.

slope_per_hour.title: Slope Per Hour
slope_per_hour.description: absolute_change divided by the elapsed hours between the two checkpoints.

acceleration.title: Acceleration
acceleration.description: Always null in the 0/24 h mode. Two observations cannot evidence acceleration; the field exists so richer checkpoint profiles can populate it later.

early_trajectory.title: Early Trajectory
early_trajectory.description: The early readings actually used, ordered by hour.

profile_id.title: Profile Id
profile_id.description: Part/test profile this component was screened under.

context.title: Context
context.description: Per-record context the upload supplied (part number, tester, board position, stress and measurement conditions). Presentation only - never a predictive input.

UnscoredRecord.title: UnscoredRecord
UnscoredRecord.description:
A (component, measurement) history the service could not score.

These are reported explicitly so the UI never implies a silent pass.

explained_model.title: Explained Model
explained_model.description: Which tree model these contributions explain: 'xgboost_v2' when that model produced the forecast, otherwise the v1 'xgboost' candidate.

XgboostExplanation.title: XgboostExplanation
XgboostExplanation.description:
TreeSHAP contributions for the XGBoost candidate.

``is_active_forecast`` is false when a different model produced the forecast
shown beside it. In that case these contributions explain the CANDIDATE, not
the number on screen, and the UI must say so.
